lead: Backend and AI engineer at Razorpay since January 2024, after a B.Tech in Computer Science at RGPV, Bhopal. I take merchants' payment integrations from architecture review to production go-live. That started in Bengaluru, then Curlec in Malaysia, and now Singapore as well. Razorpay runs the checkout, APIs, and webhooks. Airwallex runs the licensed payment processing. I also built an Adaptive-RAG pipeline for an internal hackathon, and a multi-agent traffic system selected from 9,100+ projects at Google Cloud's Agentic AI Day. The title now is Technical Consultant.

roles.title: Technical Consultant · Razorpay Curlec and Razorpay Singapore
roles.subheading: I now work for merchants in both geographies, Malaysia and Singapore.

roles.title: Razorpay Singapore
roles.subheading: Razorpay International Services Pte. Ltd. partners with Airwallex (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., a payment service provider licensed under Singapore's Payment Services Act 2019, so Singapore merchants can accept payments.
points: Razorpay supplies the technical layer: checkout, APIs, webhooks, and integration support.
Airwallex runs the regulated payment processing and holds the funds.
Razorpay Singapore is not licensed under the Act and does not provide the payment service itself.

roles.title: Razorpay Curlec
roles.subheading: Curlec is the Razorpay group company in Malaysia.
points: Led 15 to 20 API and SDK integrations a week from architecture review through production go-live, across gateway, webhook, and auth flows, and more than 30 escalations with engineering.
Cut merchant onboarding time by roughly 40% by writing integration docs with working code examples.
Read production code in PHP, Go, and JavaScript to find regression points. I fixed the smaller issues directly and handed the rest to engineering with a clear repro.
Analyzed production logs for timeouts, retries, and idempotency across distributed payment flows, so a repeated attempt was not treated as a new payment.
Translated merchant requirements into API-level recommendations their engineering teams could act on.

roles.title: Associate Technical Consultant · Razorpay
roles.subheading: Joined Razorpay on payments and integrations.
points: Merchant-facing work from day one: payment APIs and SDKs, from the first architecture review through a live checkout.
